source_memory_room.name: Context And Source Memory

agents.claim: Use derived patterns and source IDs only.
Prioritize public identity mirror and concrete couple receipts.
Avoid repeating cooled-down lanes as fresh ideas.

source_memory_room.summary: Source memory loaded before concept selection.

story_meaning_room.name: Story Meaning Room

agents.claim: The route needs obstacle, proof, reversal, and earned payoff.
The meaning must be drawable through behavior.
Aachu gets spark; Zuv gets active response.
No obstacle means no story engine.

story_meaning_room.summary: Generated 5 story routes and selected Proof Before Poetry as the strongest raw meaning.

audience_algorithm_room.name: Audience And Algorithm Room

agents.claim: The route must create curiosity and middle-slide re-engagement.
The route needs a send/save/tag reason.
Public copy should stay name-free and behavior-led.
The humor should feel warm, desi, and non-shaming.

audience_algorithm_room.summary: Audience pass checked reader mirror, send/save logic, and taste.

selected_outputs.distribution_reason: Saveable when it gives viewers language for a familiar relationship pattern.

contrarian_repair_room.name: Contrarian Repair Room

agents.claim: The winner must survive genericness and private-context objections.
Specific proof beats beat abstract romance.
No shaming, privacy leak, or copied expression.
The concept must become simple scenes.

contrarian_repair_room.summary: Top routes were attacked and repair needs were recorded.

final_synthesis_room.name: Final Synthesis Room

agents.claim: Write emotional machine into C/D/B contracts.

final_synthesis_room.summary: Final selector synthesized the route into Layer E handoff fields.

exploration_routes.name: Proof Before Poetry
exploration_routes.story_lens: The story should begin with the behavior that proves love, not the romantic summary.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Readers enter through a concrete couple behavior they recognize.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The idea risks becoming pretty but emotionally flat.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu carries the expressive pressure in the moment.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv must make one visible choice toward her.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Suitcase Relocation. Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house. She packed just options. He packed every charger except the one they needed. They sat on the suitcase. Still forgot toothbrushes. Nobody blamed each other. Only the zip. Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The surface moment becomes proof of care.
exploration_routes.payoff: Love becomes believable only after the scene proves it.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Saveable when it gives viewers language for a familiar relationship pattern.

exploration_routes.name: Public Scene, Private Meaning
exploration_routes.story_lens: Turn the visible scene into a private relationship truth.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: A stranger can enter through the public scene first.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: If the private meaning is absent, the scene stays decorative.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's reaction gives the scene emotional charge.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv's care must be visible in frame.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Suitcase Relocation. Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house. She packed just options. He packed every charger except the one they needed. They sat on the suitcase. Still forgot toothbrushes. Nobody blamed each other. Only the zip. Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The public image becomes a private receipt.
exploration_routes.payoff: The pretty part is only proof; the relationship is the subject.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Shareable if the scene becomes a relationship mirror.

exploration_routes.name: Anti-Ideal To Real Love
exploration_routes.story_lens: Reject polished romance and find the real imperfect dynamic.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Viewers recognize the gap between ideal romance and real couple behavior.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The route fails if no tension or role is visible.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv must respond with grounded behavior.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Suitcase Relocation. Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house. She packed just options. He packed every charger except the one they needed. They sat on the suitcase. Still forgot toothbrushes. Nobody blamed each other. Only the zip. Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The imperfection becomes the reason it feels true.
exploration_routes.payoff: Real love is specific enough to be inconvenient.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Sendable when it names what perfect romance misses.

exploration_routes.name: Reader As Third Witness
exploration_routes.story_lens: Let the reader feel seen before explaining the couple.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: The viewer recognizes their own desire to be understood.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The route becomes advice if Aachu/Zuv proof is weak.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Suitcase Relocation. Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house. She packed just options. He packed every charger except the one they needed. They sat on the suitcase. Still forgot toothbrushes. Nobody blamed each other. Only the zip. Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: Advice turns into story once the proof appears.
exploration_routes.payoff: The lesson must feel discovered through them.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Useful for article, caption, and save behavior.

exploration_routes.name: Scene Before Summary
exploration_routes.story_lens: Start inside the moment and delay explanation until the scene earns it.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: People stay because they want the scene to resolve.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's behavior creates the scene's pressure.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv's action resolves or reframes the pressure.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Suitcase Relocation. Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house. She packed just options. He packed every charger except the one they needed. They sat on the suitcase. Still forgot toothbrushes. Nobody blamed each other. Only the zip. Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The scene reveals what the summary could not.
exploration_routes.payoff: The final line lands only after the action.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Retention comes from wanting the next panel.
